hero.title: Oil rises as concerns over Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia eclipse supply recovery
hero.description: Iran's move to step up attacks on tankers which are transiting through the Strait of Hormuz has also led to renewed worries over oil supplies among traders.

latest.title: Oil rises as concerns over Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia eclipse supply recovery
latest.description: Iran's move to step up attacks on tankers which are transiting through the Strait of Hormuz has also led to renewed worries over oil supplies among traders.

latest.title: Singapore's Temasek warns of the ‘biggest risk’ facing markets right now
latest.description: Unwinding of the artificial intelligence trade poses the biggest risk to markets, according to Singapore state-owned investment giant Temasek.

latest.title: India’s central bank hikes rates for the first time since 2023 as inflation risks build
latest.description: HSBC and Goldman Sachs expect the RBI to raise interest rates in December as well.

latest.title: Luxury developers flocked to the 'Hamptons of Hungary' — but some projects are stalling
latest.description: Lake Balaton in south-west Hungary has been a popular vacation destination for decades, but average transaction prices are falling.

latest.title: Kalshi’s 15-min gold markets overtake Ether just weeks after launch
latest.description: Gold recorded 542 million contracts and an estimated $5 million in fees in September, surpassing Ether’s 318 million contracts and $2.6 million, though Bitcoin remained far ahead.

latest.title: Pudgy Penguins’ Abstract becomes second Ethereum layer 2 to shut in a week
latest.description: The consumer-focused blockchain will close Dec. 15 after Igloo spent tens of millions supporting it, days after Blast said its own network was no longer worth operating.

latest.title: Trump set to talk to Russia's Putin 'very soon' about plague-related death in Siberia
latest.description: Trump says he will speak with Putin “very soon” over a plague incident in Russia as CDC monitor the situation.

latest.title: Cardano gives token issuers power to freeze, seize and restrict assets
latest.description: The new standard is aimed at regulated stablecoins, funds and bonds whose issuers need identity checks, sanctions controls and other transfer rules built into the asset itself.

latest.title: Bitcoin dips below $84,000 as oil jumps on Iranian tanker attacks
latest.description: Bitcoin briefly broke under the level analysts flagged as the point where sellers take over. Oil and the dollar both climbed.

latest.title: Trump isn't ‘completely wrong’: Hormuz disruption is Asia’s problem, says Singapore's foreign minister
latest.description: Trump has said that Asian economies, which are heavily reliant on energy shipped through Hormuz, should shoulder more of the burden of keeping the waterway open.

latest.title: Bitcoin.de trading remains halted as German regulator rejects MiCA application
latest.description: Trading on the platform has largely been suspended since June as its operator awaited MiCA authorization, with the company now looking to regulated partners to restart services.

latest.title: Trillions are being ‘wasted’ on the AI boom, Arthur Hayes says. He’s betting on what comes next
latest.description: Former BitMEX CEO Arthur Hayes says the AI infrastructure boom is being overbuilt and is betting an eventual crash and bailout will send crypto higher.

latest.title: Pudgy Penguins-backed Abstract to shut down after ‘tens of millions’ in losses
latest.description: Igloo CEO Luca Netz said the company funded Abstract for 18 months but still failed to find product-market fit despite attracting major brands and a community of millions.

latest.title: Google Launches Nano Banana 2.1: Better Than Its Predecessor at Half the Price
latest.description: Google's new image model, Nano Banana 2.1, is live. It costs about half as much as its predecessor, but the performance claims come from Google's own tests.

latest.title: Circle Welcomes DJ Khaled to 'Team USDC' and Crypto Twitter Is Furious
latest.description: Nothing in Circle's posts announces a sponsorship, but replies dug up Khaled's 2018 SEC settlement over a crypto fraud he promoted. The internet never forgets.

latest.title: Cramer says these blue-chip stocks are among the best ways to invest in the AI boom
latest.description: Jim Cramer said established tech giants with strong businesses and multiple ways to benefit from AI are some of the best places to invest in the boom.

latest.title: Someone Scraped 5.6 Billion TikTok Videos and Put the Data on Hugging Face for Free
latest.description: A developer posted metadata for about 5.6 billion public TikTok videos, scraped through the app's private API in a way TikTok's terms prohibit. The free dataset also doubles as a storefront.

latest.title: Trump hedges on paying back government for ads that already aired
latest.description: The New York Times reported "Trump personally instructed his budget director to use taxpayer money for TV ads praising him and his presidency."

latest.title: Russia plague: How great is the global risk? Maybe low, but infectious disease experts want more data
latest.description: Uncertainty surrounds the death of an employee at a Russian anti-plague institute. Here's what infectious disease experts say about how worried you should be.

latest.title: Conduit sues Tether over allegedly freezing $2.8M without explanation
latest.description: The lawsuit alleged that Tether froze USDt funds in a Conduit wallet tied to an investigation launched by Brazilian authorities in 2024.
